Name: Let's Get This Fish
Author: daniel4242
Description:
Set's the fishing mini-game progress bar to 100% with [b]Right Click[/b] [b]and while the mini-game is active[/b]. 

Meant to be an in between of skipping fishing completely and Vanilla fishing.
I made it because sometimes you know the fish will be caught (eventually... I'm looking at you [i]Pike[/i] and [i]Chub[/i]) but you don't want to wait to manually complete it.

The fish [b]does[/b] have to be actively in the green square for completion. Will keep "Perfect Catch" intact as long as it hasn't already been lost, as well as if you have manually caught treasure.

Note: If you want to get a perfect catch every time you can just spam Right Click.

Manifest.Name: Let's Get This Fish
Manifest.Description: Press a key during fishing to instantly set the bobber bar to the bottom and catch the fish immediately.
Manifest.Author: daniel4242
